data.action: 在冰茶旁写角色分析笔记，抬头微笑交谈
data.description: 【黑川茜 · 咖啡店对谈】咖啡厅明亮的窗边，黑川茜穿着蓝色围裙连衣裙与白衬衫，面前放着一杯冰茶。她仔细写下角色分析笔记，随后抬起闪烁着星瞳的双眼，向你露出温柔而认真的笑容——「每记下一点新的理解，就觉得离这个角色更近了一步。也想听听你的看法呢。」
data.promptProse: Akane sits by the bright cafe window in her blue pinafore dress, white blouse and black heels, writing character-analysis notes before looking up with a warm, serious smile. The full-body view keeps her shoes beneath the chair and iced tea beside the notebook on the table. Soft window light brightens the open page and sleeve folds, while the chair and table cast quiet shadows across the floor.
data.title: 黑川茜 · 咖啡店对谈
